purpose: sprint selection of the v2 calibration rows and a component-disjoint holdout; estimates, superseded by the builder's exact lengths

estimate_rules.keyframe: adapt to the 1344x768 canvas area at source aspect, round to 32
estimate_rules.video: 1008 tokens per second of contract duration
estimate_rules.text: released tokenizer count of the row's target_ir, the H3 prompt, no special tokens

strata.axes: primary_role x marker presence in target_ir
strata.markers_source: vendor_config.h3_markers(): declared additional_special_tokens with no added_tokens_decoder entry, i.e. the ones the release appends past the stock vocabulary
strata.axis_reach: the marker axis separates only the markers this pool actually carries; see markers_observed_in_pool. A marker at zero rows is one no selection from this pool can put weight on, whatever the stratum is called
strata.language_overlay: skipped: the pool row schema records channel, primary_role, picture_roles and overlays (wide_or_tall/small_source/markers/audio_label/video_audio_track) and no language field. A language tag is observable inside the <d>[...] blocks of target_ir; deriving it here would be this selector inventing a pool field

max_vision_tokens_per_row.applies_to: calibration only; a vision cap on the holdout would choose which geometries the holdout grades
max_vision_tokens_per_row.note: rows over the cap are skipped, never truncated: a truncated presentation is not what the deployed path emits

component_map.caveat: every candidate crossing a component boundary is ruled, and the 19 video file(s) were additionally inspected exhaustively rather than through the window. What remains unexamined is the IMAGE population beyond Hamming 6: the video pass found a pair at more than twice that distance which is the same shot list rendered twice, so same-brief-different-render relatedness exists in this source and this window cannot reach it. That class is unexamined among the images, where the population is too large to inspect by eye
component_map.basis: exact media SHA-256 components unioned with adjudicated perceptual duplicate and uncertain edges
component_map.assignment: corrected visual family, not exact media component

text_only_selection.constraint: MEASURED, 2026-08-24_calibration_input_seam.md Q1a/Q1b: one `oneshot` call traces the model once and that trace fixes the modality envelope for the whole run. A text-only row after a vision trace raises; a vision row after a text-only trace loses its media silently. These rows are therefore a SEPARATE bundle and a separate run -- `build_native_h3_calibration_batch.py --population text-only` -- or they need a second traced graph, which is a change to llm-compressor's sequential pipeline. They are not merged into `calibration` here so the choice is made rather than inherited
